critique: The note proves sharp linear-program identified sets under arbitrary finite linear response-type restrictions and, under Strong Monotonicity, an exact Cartesian stayer–harm prism, closed-form sharp ratio endpoints, and the stated unavoidable-harm iff certificate. The framing accurately limits the closed form to Strong Monotonicity and does not present that inherited restriction as novel. It does not prove the advertised numerical-delta validity at simultaneous hinge ties and structural-zero cells: the relevant definition merely invokes Hong–Li after premises that remain unchecked, so no directional-inference result is delivered. The projected paper score is constrained by that missing inference theorem and by the absence of an empirical or software demonstration beyond a single two-layer witness, although neither defect negates the field-level identification contribution.
